attributes.name: Heavy Iron Shield
attributes.powers:
If you played a card that has the 2-Handed or Shield trait on this check, you may not play this card. 

If proficient with heavy armors, on your combat check, after the roll, recharge this card to reroll 1 die; take the new result. You may play another armor on this check.
